title: Add skill discovery to plan.py task decomposition
prompt:
Task: Add skill discovery to plan.py task decomposition

Implementation:
- Add _discover_skills(task_title, task_body) function to plan.py
- It calls recommend-skill-chain/run.sh recommend --task '{title}: {body}' --json --limit 5
- Parse JSON output, extract skill names with confidence > 0.5
- Auto-populate the skills field on Task dataclass
- Call _discover_skills in to_dict or during plan emission for each task
- If recommend-skill-chain is unavailable, fall back to manifest keyword search

Definition of Done:
- Command: cd .pi/skills/plan && python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('plan.py').read()); print('OK')"
- Assertion: OK
